explanation: It was filmed before a studio audience in Burbank, California. The fountain in the opening titles stands on the Warner Bros. lot there.

claims.text: The sitcom Friends is set in New York City.
Friends is not set in Chicago, Boston or Los Angeles.
Friends was filmed before a studio audience at Warner Bros. in Burbank, California.
The fountain seen in the Friends opening titles is on the Warner Bros. lot in Burbank.

writerNotes: Self-check 9.3. Lint: clean. Claims: every claim listed, risk at or above the C26 floor; the schema's riskReason list has no only or counterintuitive, so such claims carry the nearest listed reason. Datasets: geonames-cities lists Burbank (US), which supports only the place name. Rival test: Boston and Chicago are homes of other famous sitcoms, and the show was filmed in Los Angeles County, which makes Los Angeles a tempting wrong pick. Volatility: evergreen; no time words; nothing depends on events after mid-2026. Regional: the work is known worldwide and the options need no single country's local knowledge. Style: Oxford spelling, straight single quotes, plain hyphens, explanation of 23 words. Myths: claims screened against myths.json, no match. Mystery and encore: not applicable to a practice item. Doubts: none beyond the high-risk claims flagged for external evidence.

evidence.restatement: It is not set in Chicago, Boston or Los Angeles.
Friends was taped before a live studio audience at Warner Bros. in Burbank.
The fountain in the opening titles stands on Warner Bros. property in Burbank, the Warner Bros. Ranch backlot.

claimResults.note: See the wording note: 'the Warner Bros. lot' could be read as the main lot.

issues.note: The opening-titles fountain is on the Warner Bros. Ranch, a separate Warner Bros. backlot in Burbank, rather than the main studio lot where the show was taped. 'A Warner Bros. lot there' would be exact; the key is unaffected.
